metadata.description: Icon Playground: restyle the Windows taskbar and desktop with your agent, and design custom icons.

plugins.name: iconwright
plugins.description: An MCP server that restyles your Windows taskbar and desktop: change any app's icon, pin, unpin and reorder taskbar apps, and arrange desktop icons, with undo for everything. It also designs custom icons from 200,000+ open-source icons, previews them on a real taskbar, desktop and phone, and exports .ico, .icns and favicons.
